name: setttle-agent
description: Help Setttle users review books, reconcile activity, prepare reports, and record confirmed changes.

com.openai.longDescription: Connect Setttle to review your company books, reconcile bank activity, prepare financial reports, and record bookkeeping changes you confirm. Setttle keeps a double-entry ledger for one or more companies in CAD and USD. Recording a payment writes a ledger entry only; Setttle never moves money.
defaultPrompt: Review my Setttle books and tell me what needs attention.
Find unmatched bank transactions from last month and suggest matches.
Prepare a profit and loss for this quarter.
